# Requirements Document: Catches, titles and the streak

## Introduction

What a person's standing rests on, and what brings them back each week.

Each criterion carries where it comes from. *modelled* means the sentence was computed by running the model. *proven* means Lean checked a theorem for every input, shown with its statement. *open question* means the model shows a problem and someone has to decide.

## Requirements

### Requirement RG-005

**Title:** Titles

**User Story:** As an expert, I want a title that reflects the quality of my reviews, so that going fast earns nothing.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a person has at least 6 upheld catches and 6 passed check cards THE SYSTEM SHALL give the title Station manager.
   - RG-005.1, modelled
   - Read by running `Standing.title` (model/Game/Standing.lean:52), and checked in every engine by the vectors
2. WHEN a person has at least 3 upheld catches and 3 passed check cards, and has not reached the next bar THE SYSTEM SHALL give the title Duty manager.
   - RG-005.2, modelled
   - Read by running `Standing.title` (model/Game/Standing.lean:52), and checked in every engine by the vectors
3. WHEN a person has fewer than 3 upheld catches or fewer than 3 passed check cards THE SYSTEM SHALL give the title Shift lead.
   - RG-005.3, modelled
   - Read by running `Standing.title` (model/Game/Standing.lean:52), and checked in every engine by the vectors
4. WHEN a person answers more cases THE SYSTEM SHALL leave their title as it is.
   - RG-005.4, proven
   - Theorem `answering_keeps_title` (model/Game/Standing.lean:71)
   - Lean: `∀ (s : Game.Standing) (n : Nat), { answered := s.answered + n, upheld := s.upheld, checksPassed := s.checksPassed }.title = s.title`
5. WHEN any outcome except a passed check is recorded THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the person's title as it is.
   - RG-005.5, proven
   - Theorem `recording_keeps_title` (model/Game/Standing.lean:75)
   - Lean: `∀ (s : Game.Standing) (o : Game.Outcome), o ≠ Game.Outcome.checkPassed → (s.record o).title = s.title`
6. THE SYSTEM SHALL never lower a title when catches are upheld or check cards are passed.
   - RG-005.6, proven
   - Theorem `title_never_falls` (model/Game/Standing.lean:85)
   - Lean: `∀ (a b : Game.Standing), a.upheld ≤ b.upheld → a.checksPassed ≤ b.checksPassed → a.title.rank ≤ b.title.rank`

### Requirement RG-006

**Title:** Reviewing a catch

**User Story:** As an area owner, I want to decide each catch once, so that a catch means someone accountable agreed.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. IF the finder of a catch tries to review it THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse the review.
   - RG-006.1, proven
   - Theorem `finder_cannot_review` (model/Game/Standing.lean:25)
   - Lean: `∀ (c : Game.Catch) (uphold : Bool), c.review c.finder uphold = none`
2. IF a catch has already been decided THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse another review.
   - RG-006.2, proven
   - Theorem `review_is_final` (model/Game/Standing.lean:28)
   - Lean: `∀ (c : Game.Catch) (owner : Nat) (uphold : Bool), c.state ≠ Game.CatchState.pending → c.review owner uphold = none`
3. WHEN a catch is pending or dismissed THE SYSTEM SHALL give the finder no credit for it.
   - RG-006.3, proven
   - Theorem `unupheld_catch_earns_nothing` (model/Game/Standing.lean:80)
   - Lean: `∀ (s : Game.Standing) (c : Game.Catch), c.state ≠ Game.CatchState.upheld → s.credit c = s`

### Requirement RG-007

**Title:** The weekly streak

**User Story:** As an expert, I want a week off not to cost me my streak, so that the game fits around my job.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a week closes with at least one answer of any kind THE SYSTEM SHALL extend the streak by one week.
   - RG-007.1, proven
   - Theorem `one_answer_extends` (model/Game/Streak.lean:22)
   - Lean: `∀ (s : Game.Streak), (s.closeWeek true).weeks = s.weeks + 1`
2. WHEN a week closes with at least one answer THE SYSTEM SHALL spend no standby pass.
   - RG-007.2, proven
   - Theorem `answering_spends_no_pass` (model/Game/Streak.lean:24)
   - Lean: `∀ (s : Game.Streak), (s.closeWeek true).passes = s.passes`
3. WHEN a week closes with no answer and a standby pass in hand THE SYSTEM SHALL spend one pass and keep the streak.
   - RG-007.3, proven
   - Theorem `pass_protects_streak` (model/Game/Streak.lean:26)
   - Lean: `∀ (s : Game.Streak), 0 < s.passes → (s.closeWeek false).weeks = s.weeks ∧ (s.closeWeek false).passes = s.passes - 1`
4. WHEN a week closes with no answer and no standby pass THE SYSTEM SHALL end the streak.
   - RG-007.4, proven
   - Theorem `no_pass_ends_streak` (model/Game/Streak.lean:31)
   - Lean: `∀ (s : Game.Streak), s.passes = 0 → (s.closeWeek false).weeks = 0`
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL start each person with 2 standby passes and never add to them when a week closes.
   - RG-007.5, proven
   - Theorem `passes_never_grow` (model/Game/Streak.lean:34)
   - Lean: `∀ (s : Game.Streak) (a : Bool), (s.closeWeek a).passes ≤ s.passes`
